text: 美国银行在一份报告中表示，自9月中旬以来，期限溢价上升推动了发达市场中长期债券收益率走高。利率策略师Ralf Preusser周三在报告中写道，“与其归咎于债券义警、财政赤字、日本、财政主导或央行独立性受侵蚀，利率上升的推动因素是各国央行实施加息”。（彭博）
text_en: Bank of America said in a report that rising term premiums since mid-September have driven long-term bond yields higher in developed markets. Interest rate strategist Ralf Preusser wrote in a report on Wednesday that "rather than blaming bond vigilantes, fiscal deficits, Japan, fiscal dominance or eroding central bank independence, the driver of rising rates is central banks raising interest rates." (Bloomberg)
